pre_execution_questions.question: What exact artifact is the immutable comparison baseline, and how is its identity preserved?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Without a frozen baseline later architecture changes cannot be compared reliably.

pre_execution_questions.question: Which architecture artifacts are canonical inputs and which are generated views?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: The map must not become a second source of truth.

pre_execution_questions.question: How will the map distinguish implemented components from planned components?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: A user must not confuse roadmap items with working runtime capabilities.

pre_execution_questions.question: Which changes require System Map regeneration?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Living documentation only works if drift has an explicit trigger.

pre_execution_questions.question: Must the map and development plan be included in every release handoff?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: The map is useful only if it travels with the system.

post_execution_answers.answer: The v1.9 release is the frozen comparison baseline and its identity/digest is recorded in REFERENCE/BASELINE_v1.9.md.
post_execution_answers.decision: Treat later stages as deltas from the recorded v1.9 baseline.

post_execution_answers.answer: Canonical architecture inputs are declared by CORE/SYSTEM_MAP_SPEC.json; REFERENCE/SYSTEM_MAP.md/json/mmd are generated outputs.
post_execution_answers.decision: Only canonical inputs may own architecture semantics.

post_execution_answers.answer: Development status is explicit: implemented nodes come from canonical registries; future capabilities remain in the planned overlay/status.
post_execution_answers.decision: Never render planned elements as implemented.

post_execution_answers.answer: Changes to system spec, use-case/golden-path registries, architecture budget, stage status, result/UI composition, methods/tools/schemas require regeneration.
post_execution_answers.decision: Map parity is part of release discipline.

post_execution_answers.answer: Yes. System Map and Development Plan are release artifacts referenced from README/START_HERE.
post_execution_answers.decision: Include them in manifest/package and handoff.
